title: An owner sees who shares their business on flowweb.app, invites people by link, changes roles and removes people, and anyone in two businesses can switch between them
description: FW-C-083 gave the hosted /v1 businesses, members, roles and invite links, but nothing on the site shows them, so the Owner cannot add a friend without SQL. Settings on the site gains a People panel after Machines: the members of the chosen business with their roles; for owners and admins a role select and a Remove button (asks first) on everyone else, the open invites with Cancel, and an invite form (role, optional email, whole business or one flow) that answers a /join/ link to copy. Helpers and viewers see the people but no controls, and can leave. A login with no business can make one there. With more than one business a Business select picks one, and every later hosted /v1 call carries it as x-fw-account. hosted/roles.ts is the screens' copy of the server's role table and must agree with it.
acceptance: Settings on the site shows a People panel after Machines and before Session, listing members and open invites
An owner or admin makes an invite link (role, optional email, whole business or one flow; admins whole business only) and can copy it
An owner or admin changes another member's role, removes them only after confirming, and cancels an invite
A helper or viewer sees no invite, role or remove controls and can leave the business
A login with no business can make one from the panel
With two businesses, the chosen one is sent as x-fw-account on every later hosted /v1 call
hosted/roles.ts can(role, action) agrees with hosted/server/accounts.mjs for every role and action
